candidate.scope: The assigned poster icSHAPE row, expanded there as In vivo click selective 2′-hydroxyl acylation and profiling experiment (also called In Vivo Click SHAPE in the primary paper): in-cell NAI-N3 probing of RNA, DIBO-biotin tagging, reverse transcription, streptavidin capture and cDNA elution. This is the schematic implementation, with the RNA:cDNA capture interface resolved from the cited primary sources. RNA Structure is the panel heading; adjacent SHAPE-Seq and CIRS-seq rows and the free hairpin beside the method name are contextual/descriptive elements. The two example RNAs share one unbranched arrow route and illustrate population members with different modification positions, not independent workflows or an explicit sample split. The depicted endpoint is an enriched cDNA library precursor, not a fully specified sequencing-ready library. RNA extraction and preparation, downstream library completion, controls and analytical workflows described in papers are not reconstructed as unshown graph operations.

operations.label: Add azide group
operations.description: NAI-N3 is added to living cells and covalently modifies reactive RNA 2′-hydroxyls, leaving azide-bearing SHAPE adducts at probed positions. The RNA backbone is not depicted as being cleaved by this step.
